name: Indian Grill
kurzbeschreibung:
**Indian Grill in Tirol**

Discover the vibrant flavors of **Tirol** with a twist at our **Indian Grill**! Indulge in a unique fusion of traditional **Tiroler** cuisine and bold Indian spices. From aromatic **Currywurst** with a **Tiroler** twist to fragrant **Tandoori** dishes, every bite is a journey through diverse tastes.

Start your evening with a refreshing **Radler** or a crisp **Tiroler** beer, then dive into mouthwatering **Kaiserschmarrn** with a hint of **Garam Masala**. Our menu features **Dosa** with **Apfelstrudel** jam, **Butter Chicken** paired with **Kartoffelknödel**, and **Mango Lassi** to cleanse your palate.

Whether you're exploring **Innsbruck**, strolling through **Hallstatt**, or relaxing in the **Zillertal**, our **Indian Grill** brings a taste of the world to **Tirol**. Come experience the perfect blend of local charm and global flavors—only here in the heart of the Alps!
